"""Scratch: which test sources name a moved list, a prompt or brief, or a judge's reader, and a live root."""
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1])
KEYS = ("load_sensitive", "accepted_reds", "accepted_history", "acceptance_exemptions")
PLACES = ("governance/project/prompts", "governance/project/briefs", "governance/project/records",
          "LEAD-w2-common", "w2-orchestrator.md", "w1-orchestrator.md")
READERS = ("gov.close.traceability", "traceability", "\"check\"", "'check'", "gov check", "\"close\"",
           "gov.close.ratchet", "gov.close.history", "gov.close.gates", "judged_history", "counted_entries",
           "trailers")
LIVE = ("REPO_ROOT", "repo_root", "parents[3]", "show-toplevel")

for path in sorted((ROOT / "tests" / "acceptance").rglob("*.py")):
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    keys = [k for k in KEYS if k in text]
    places = [p for p in PLACES if p in text]
    readers = [r for r in READERS if r in text]
    live = [m for m in LIVE if m in text]
    if keys or places or (readers and live):
        print(path.relative_to(ROOT), "| keys", keys, "| places", places, "| readers", readers, "| live", live)
